        // SMTP credentials come from configuration (user-secrets locally,

    /// <summary>
    /// Handles the login command and generates a login response.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request">The LoginCommand request.</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">A cancellation token.</param>
    /// <returns>A LoginResponse containing authentication information.</returns>
    public async Task<LoginResponse> Handle(LoginCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            // Find the user by username
            var user = await _userRepository.GetUserByName(request.UserName);

            // Check if the user exists and the password is correct
            if (user != null)
            {
                // Sign in the user
                var result = await _signInManager.PasswordSignInAsync(user, request.Password, false, lockoutOnFailure: false);

                // Check if the sign-in was successful
                if (result.Succeeded)
                {
                    // Generate a JWT token
                    var token = _tokenProvider.GenerateAccessToken(user);

                    // Adapt user entity to UserResponse model
                    var userResponse = user.Adapt<UserResponse>();

                    // Create the login response
                    var response = new LoginResponse()
                    {
                        User = userResponse,
                        AccessToken = token,
                        IsAutheticated = true,
                        Message = "Logged In Successfully",
                        // Spec §6.1 codes, not the stored legacy labels: the UI
                        // gates on these, and §6.4 requires one shared role
                        // vocabulary between API and interface.
                        Roles = RoleCodes.Normalize(user.GetRoleNames()).ToList(),
                    };

                    return response;
                }

<details><summary>Tool output</summary>

```
  2339 total
# Unit Journey

## Purpose

A single unit's commercial lifecycle assembled into five stages — reservation,
notaire, vente, livraison, SAV — shown at `/admin/units/:id` and embedded inside
the reservation detail modal.

The API has no "everything for this unit" endpoint, so the join is performed
client-side from list endpoints. `useUnitJourney` owns that assembly so both call
sites produce identical results.

## Backend endpoints consumed

Backend documents live in the separate backend repository; paths below are the
frontend's verified calls.

| Endpoint | Trigger and request | Response use |
|---|---|---|
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/Reservations/list` | `useUnitJourney`, `pageSize: 100` | Narrowed locally to `r.unitId === unitId`; the newest is the unit's reservation. |
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/NotaryAppointments` | Same `Promise.all`, `pageSize: 100` | Matched on `n.reservationId === reservation.id`. |
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/after-sales/claims` | Same `Promise.all`, `pageSize: 100`, wrapped in `.catch(() => ({ data: [] }))` | Filtered to `c.unitId === unitId`. |
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/sales/user/{userId}` | Only when the reservation has a `buyerId`; wrapped in try/catch | `summary.sales.find(s => s.unitId === unitId)`. |
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/Handovers/reservations/{id}/mine` | Only when a reservation exists; wrapped in try/catch | Delivery stage. |
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/Immeuble/{id}` and `/api/Immeuble/by-immeuble` | `UnitJourneyPage` resolving the unit from the route id | Unit record and its building. |
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/Immeuble` | Fallback when no building id is supplied, `pageSize: 100` | Scans buildings, fetching each one's units until the unit is found. |
| `GET ProjectAPI /api/construction/units/{unitId}/title` | Title card on the page | Land-title status and history. |
| `PATCH ProjectAPI /api/construction/units/{unitId}/title` | Title edit modal submit | Reloads the title card. |

## Components involved

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `features/journey/useUnitJourney.ts` | Fetches, joins and derives the five stages |
| `features/journey/JourneyStepper.tsx` | Horizontal stage indicator |
| `features/journey/JourneyTimeline.tsx` | Chronological detail per stage |
| `features/journey/UnitJourneyPage.tsx` | Route page: unit header, title card, payment schedule presence, journey |
| `features/reservations/ReservationsPage.tsx` | Second consumer, via `ReservationJourney` |

## State and data flow

'''mermaid
flowchart TD
  H["useUnitJourney(unitId)"] --> PA["Promise.all"]
  PA --> R["GET /api/Reservations/list (pageSize 100)"]
  PA --> N["GET /api/NotaryAppointments (pageSize 100)"]
  PA --> C["GET /api/after-sales/claims (catch -> [])"]
  R --> F["filter unitId, take newest"]
  F --> S["GET /api/sales/user/{buyerId} (try/catch)"]
  F --> D["GET /api/Handovers/reservations/{id}/mine (try/catch)"]
  F & N & C & S & D --> B["buildStages()"]
  B --> ST[JourneyStepper]
  B --> TL[JourneyTimeline]
'''

The hook holds `journey` as `UnitJourney | null` and resets it to `null` before
each run, so switching units shows the loading state rather than the previous
unit's data.

`buildStages` derives each stage's `StageState` (`todo` / `current` / `done` /
`blocked`) from what was found. Two status sets drive it:

- `DEAD_STATUSES` = `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED`, `EXPIRED` — the reservation ended
  rather than advanced;
- `IN_PROGRESS_STATUSES` = `DRAFT`, `SUBMITTED`, `CHANGES_REQUESTED` — still
  awaiting a decision.

`empty` is set when nothing at all has happened on the unit, so the UI can render
a single empty state instead of five `todo` stages.

`UnitJourneyPage` resolves the unit itself: if the query string supplies a
building id it fetches that building and its units directly; otherwise it lists
up to 100 buildings and fetches each one's units in turn until it finds the unit.

## UI behavior notes

- The claims call is deliberately tolerant: `claimsApi.list` is admin/technician
  only, so an agent viewing the journey gets a 403 that is caught and turned into
  an empty list rather than failing the whole `Promise.all`.
- The sales and handover lookups are likewise individually wrapped, so a missing
  sale or an unscheduled handover leaves that stage `todo` instead of erroring.
- The title card is editable in place; changing the status opens a small modal
  and re-reads afterwards.
- The same stepper and timeline render inside the reservation detail modal via
  `ReservationJourney`.

## Known edge cases

- Every join is done over a **single page of 100 rows**. A unit whose
  reservation, notary appointment or claim falls outside the first 100 of the
  respective list is shown as having none. There is no per-unit filter on those
  endpoints, and no paging loop here.
- `salesApi.getByUser` is keyed on the reservation's `buyerId`, so a walk-in
  buyer with no account never resolves a sale and the "vente" stage stays `todo`
  even after a notarial conversion.
- `handoversApi.getMyStatus` is reservation-scoped and its backend handler admits
  internal roles through the project perimeter, so an agent sees the delivery
  stage; a caller outside the perimeter gets a 403 that is caught and treated as
  "no delivery".
- The fallback unit lookup in `UnitJourneyPage` issues one request per building
  until it finds a match — up to 101 requests for a unit in the last building.
- The journey is assembled from five endpoints with no shared caching, and it is
  re-assembled independently each time the reservation modal opens.
- `notaryApi.listAppointments` is matched on `reservationId`; a unit whose
  reservation was superseded and re-created would match the newest reservation
  only.

    if ($note.Length -gt 180) { $note = $note.Substring(0,180) }
  }
  $script:results += [pscustomobject]@{ id=$id; desc=$desc; who=$who; call="$method $path"; got=$r.code; want=($expect -join '/'); ok=$ok; note=$note }
  Write-Host ("{0,-6} {1,-6} {2,-3} {3} {4}" -f $id, $who, $r.code, $(if($ok){"PASS"}else{"FAIL"}), $desc)
  return $r
}
function J($r) { if ($r.body) { try { return $r.body | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { return $null } } return $null }

$ts = Get-Date -Format "MMdd-HHmmss"
$tag = "QA-E2E-$ts"
Write-Host "=== dossier tag: $tag ==="

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- SETUP
$r = Step "S1" "create project (SUR_PLAN)" admin POST "/api/Projects" @{
  name = "$tag"; location = "Casablanca"; address = "12 avenue QA"
  description = "Jeu de donnees E2E automatise"; statusGlobal = "UnderConstruction"
  warrantyMonths = 24; images = @()
} @(200,201)
$proj = J $r
$projectId = $proj.id
Write-Host "  projectId=$projectId"

foreach ($m in @(@{w='agent';rc='SALES_AGENT'}, @{w='notary';rc='NOTARY'}, @{w='tech';rc='TECHNICIAN'})) {
  Step "S2.$($m.w)" "grant $($m.rc) membership" admin POST "/api/ProjectMembership" @{
    projectId = $projectId; userId = $UID[$m.w]; roleCode = $m.rc
  } @(200,201) | Out-Null
}

$r = Step "S3" "create immeuble" admin POST "/api/Immeuble" @{
  name = "$tag-B1"; projectId = $projectId; location = "Casablanca"; type = "Appartements"
  minPrice = 800000; maxPrice = 2000000; images = ""; description = "Batiment QA"
  latitude = 33.57; longitude = -7.59; status = "UnderConstruction"
  numberOfUnits = 2; minSellableSurfaceRange = 60; maxSellableSurfaceRange = 140
  numberOfSoldUnites = 0; numberOfAvailableUnites = 2; sellsPercentage = 0
} @(200,201)
$imm = J $r
# CreateImmeubleResponse names the NEW BUILDING's id "projectId" (see report F-03).
$immeubleId = $imm.projectId
Write-Host "  immeubleId=$immeubleId"

$r = Step "S4" "create floor" admin POST "/api/Immeuble/$immeubleId/floors" @{
  immeubleId = $immeubleId; name = "RDC"; sequenceNo = 0
} @(200,201)
$fl = J $r
$floorId = $fl.floorId
Write-Host "  floorId=$floorId"

$r = Step "S5" "create unit" admin POST "/api/Immeuble/$immeubleId/units" @{
  projectId = $immeubleId; floorId = $floorId; unitNumber = "RDC-QA1"
  numberOfBedrooms = 2; numberOfBathrooms = 1; apartmentSurface = 95.0
  view = "Jardin"; orientation = "Sud"; totalSurface = 105.0; price = 1250000
} @(200,201)
$un = J $r
$unitId = $un.unitId
Write-Host "  unitId=$unitId"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W1 RESERVATION
$r = Step "W1.1" "agent opens reservation" agent POST "/api/Reservations/create" @{
  buyerId = $UID['buyer']; name = "Yasmine"; lastName = "Bennani"; cin = "BE998877"
  email = "qa.buyer@example.test"; phoneNumber = "+212600112233"
  unitId = $unitId; agentId = $UID['agent']
  totalPropertyPrice = 1250000; reservationAmount = 125000
  isUnderConstruction = $true; createAsDraft = $false; discount = 0
} @(200,201)
$res = J $r
$resId = $res.reservationId
Write-Host "  reservationId=$resId"

Step "W1.2" "buyer cannot open a reservation" buyer POST "/api/Reservations/create" @{
  unitId = $unitId; totalPropertyPrice = 1; reservationAmount = 1
} @(403) | Out-Null

Step "W1.3" "admin approves" admin POST "/api/Reservations/$resId/approve" @{
  reservationId = $resId; adminUserId = $UID['admin']; adminNote = "Dossier complet (QA)"; documents = @()
} @(200) | Out-Null

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W2 SALE GATE (phase)
Step "W2.1" "sale refused while SUR_PLAN" agent POST "/api/sales" @{ reservationId = $resId } @(409) | Out-Null

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W3 COMPLETE PROJECT
Step "W3.1" "agent cannot complete project" agent POST "/api/construction/projects/$projectId/complete" @{
  projectId = $projectId; confirm = $true
} @(403) | Out-Null

Step "W3.2" "complete refused below 100% without override" admin POST "/api/construction/projects/$projectId/complete" @{
  projectId = $projectId; confirm = $true
} @(409,422) | Out-Null

Step "W3.3" "GLOBAL_ADMIN completes with override" admin POST "/api/construction/projects/$projectId/complete" @{
  projectId = $projectId; confirm = $true; overrideIncompleteProgress = $true
  overrideReason = "Recette QA automatisee - passage en livraison"
} @(200) | Out-Null

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W4 FINAL VISIT
Step "W4.0" "sale refused: final visit not cleared" agent POST "/api/sales" @{ reservationId = $resId } @(409,422) | Out-Null

$starts = (Get-Date).AddDays(2).ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:00:00")
$r = Step "W4.1" "buyer requests final visit" buyer POST "/api/final-visits/reservations/$resId/request" @{
  reservationId = $resId; startsAt = $starts
} @(200,201)
$fv = J $r
$apptId = $fv.appointmentId
$caseId = $fv.caseId
Write-Host "  finalVisitAppointment=$apptId case=$caseId"

Step "W4.2" "tech cannot drive the visit" tech POST "/api/final-visits/appointments/$apptId/transition" @{
  appointmentId = $apptId; targetStatus = 1
} @(403) | Out-Null

Step "W4.3" "agent confirms appointment" agent POST "/api/final-visits/appointments/$apptId/transition" @{
  appointmentId = $apptId; targetStatus = 1
} @(200) | Out-Null

# §17.2 — an agent may not declare a visit done before its start time, even
# asking for the override: the override is a project-admin authorisation.
Step "W4.4a" "agent refused early completion" agent POST "/api/final-visits/appointments/$apptId/transition" @{
  appointmentId = $apptId; targetStatus = 5; allowEarlyCompletion = $true
} @(422) | Out-Null

Step "W4.4b" "admin authorises early completion" admin POST "/api/final-visits/appointments/$apptId/transition" @{
  appointmentId = $apptId; targetStatus = 5; allowEarlyCompletion = $true
} @(200) | Out-Null

$r = Step "W4.5" "agent files compliant report" agent POST "/api/final-visits/appointments/$apptId/report" @{
  appointmentId = $apptId; resultCode = 0; generalCondition = "Conforme"
  observations = "Aucune reserve relevee (QA)"; snags = @()
} @(200,201)
$rep = J $r
$reportId = $rep.reportId
Write-Host "  reportId=$reportId"

Step "W4.6" "buyer acknowledges report" buyer POST "/api/final-visits/reports/$reportId/acknowledge" @{
  reportId = $reportId
} @(200) | Out-Null

$r = Step "W4.7" "eligibility still blocked by land title" agent GET "/api/final-visits/reservations/$resId/notary-eligibility" $null @(200)
$el = J $r
Write-Host "  status=$($el.status) canRequest=$($el.canRequestAppointment) title=$($el.titleStatus)"

# §16 — the land title is the second gate. Forward path NOT_AVAILABLE -> IN_PROGRESS -> AVAILABLE.
Step "W4.8" "agent cannot move the land title" agent PATCH "/api/construction/units/$unitId/title" @{
  unitId = $unitId; status = 1
} @(403) | Out-Null

Step "W4.9" "admin sets title IN_PROGRESS" admin PATCH "/api/construction/units/$unitId/title" @{
  unitId = $unitId; status = 1; reason = "Depot au service de la conservation fonciere (QA)"
} @(200) | Out-Null

Step "W4.10" "admin sets title AVAILABLE" admin PATCH "/api/construction/units/$unitId/title" @{
  unitId = $unitId; status = 2; reason = "Titre foncier obtenu (QA)"
} @(200) | Out-Null

$r = Step "W4.11" "notary eligibility cleared" agent GET "/api/final-visits/reservations/$resId/notary-eligibility" $null @(200)
$el = J $r
Write-Host "  status=$($el.status) canRequest=$($el.canRequestAppointment) title=$($el.titleStatus)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W5 SALE
$r = Step "W5.1" "agent opens sale draft" agent POST "/api/sales" @{
  reservationId = $resId; finalPrice = 1230000; notes = "Remise commerciale accordee (QA)"
} @(200,201)
$sale = J $r
$saleId = $sale.id
$saleStatus = $sale.status
Write-Host "  saleId=$saleId status=$saleStatus"

Step "W5.2" "second sale on same reservation refused" agent POST "/api/sales" @{ reservationId = $resId } @(409) | Out-Null
Step "W5.3" "buyer cannot open a sale" buyer POST "/api/sales" @{ reservationId = $resId } @(403) | Out-Null
Step "W5.4" "notary cannot open a sale" notary POST "/api/sales" @{ reservationId = $resId } @(403) | Out-Null

Step "W5.5" "agent corrects the draft" agent PUT "/api/sales/$saleId" @{
  saleId = $saleId; finalPrice = 1240000; notes = "Prix revise (QA)"
} @(200) | Out-Null

$r = Step "W5.6" "buyer reads their own sale" buyer GET "/api/sales/by-reservation/$resId" $null @(200)
Step "W5.7" "technician cannot read the sale" tech GET "/api/sales/by-reservation/$resId" $null @(403) | Out-Null

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W6 NOTARY
# A fresh slot per run: the notary's diary rejects a double booking
# (APPOINTMENT_SLOT_CONFLICT), so a fixed hour only works once.
$slotDays = 5 + (Get-Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 240)
$slotHours = Get-Random -Minimum 0 -Maximum 8
$apptDate = (Get-Date).AddDays($slotDays).AddHours($slotHours).ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:00:00")
$r = Step "W6.1" "agent books notary appointment" agent POST "/api/NotaryAppointments" @{
  reservationId = $resId; notaireId = $UID['notary']; agentId = $UID['agent']; buyerId = $UID['buyer']
  appointmentDate = $apptDate; status = "Scheduled"; taxFees = 25000; tahfidFees = 8000
} @(200,201)
$na = J $r
$naId = $na.id
Write-Host "  notaryAppointmentId=$naId"

Step "W6.2" "notary reads own appointment" notary GET "/api/NotaryAppointments/$naId" $null @(200) | Out-Null
Step "W6.3" "technician refused on notary appointment" tech GET "/api/NotaryAppointments/$naId" $null @(403) | Out-Null
Step "W6.4" "agent cannot record the outcome" agent PUT "/api/NotaryAppointments/$naId" @{
  id = $naId; outcome = "PURCHASE_COMPLETED"
} @(403) | Out-Null

# The appointment opens as Requested; Requested -> Completed is refused, the
# notary must confirm the slot first (same AppointmentAttemptStatus machine).
Step "W6.5a" "direct Requested -> Completed refused" notary PUT "/api/NotaryAppointments/$naId" @{
  id = $naId; status = "Completed"; outcome = "PURCHASE_COMPLETED"
} @(409) | Out-Null

Step "W6.5b" "notary confirms the slot" notary PUT "/api/NotaryAppointments/$naId" @{
  id = $naId; status = "Confirmed"
} @(200) | Out-Null

Step "W6.5c" "notary records PURCHASE_COMPLETED" notary PUT "/api/NotaryAppointments/$naId" @{
  id = $naId; status = "Completed"; outcome = "PURCHASE_COMPLETED"; outcomeNote = "Acte signe (QA)"
} @(200) | Out-Null

$r = Step "W6.6" "sale is now confirmed" agent GET "/api/sales/by-reservation/$resId" $null @(200)
$saleAfter = J $r
Write-Host "  sale status after notary: $($saleAfter.status)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W7 HANDOVER
$hoDate = (Get-Date).AddDays(9).ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:00:00")
$r = Step "W7.1" "agent schedules handover" agent POST "/api/Handovers" @{
  reservationId = $resId; scheduledAt = $hoDate; location = "Sur site"; notes = "Remise des cles (QA)"
} @(200,201)
$hoId = (J $r).id
Write-Host "  handoverId=$hoId"

Step "W7.2" "buyer cannot schedule a handover" buyer POST "/api/Handovers" @{
  reservationId = $resId; scheduledAt = $hoDate
} @(403) | Out-Null

Step "W7.3" "agent confirms handover" agent POST "/api/Handovers/$hoId/confirm" $null @(200,204) | Out-Null

$r = Step "W7.4" "agent files handover report" agent POST "/api/Handovers/$hoId/report" @{
  appointmentId = $hoId; participants = "Acquereur, agent"; observations = "Logement conforme (QA)"
  items = @(@{ itemType = "Cles appartement"; quantity = 3; comment = "Jeu complet" },
            @{ itemType = "Badge parking"; quantity = 1 })
} @(200,201)
$hrid = (J $r).id
Write-Host "  handoverReportId=$hrid"

Step "W7.5" "buyer acknowledges handover" buyer POST "/api/Handovers/reports/$hrid/acknowledge" @{} @(200,204) | Out-Null

$r = Step "W7.6" "buyer reads their warranties" buyer GET "/api/Handovers/reservations/$resId/warranties/mine" $null @(200)
Write-Host "  warranties: $($r.body)"

$r = Step "W7.7" "non-owner gets no warranties from the /mine route" tech GET "/api/Handovers/reservations/$resId/warranties/mine" $null @(200,403,404)
Write-Host "  tech warranties payload: $($r.body)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- W8 AFTER-SALES
$r = Step "W8.1" "buyer files a claim" buyer POST "/api/after-sales/claims" @{
  unitId = $unitId; title = "Fuite sous evier"; description = "Infiltration constatee apres remise des cles (QA)"
  category = 0; priority = 1
} @(200,201)
$cl = J $r
$claimId = $cl.id
Write-Host "  claimId=$claimId"

$r = Step "W8.2" "buyer cannot file as another buyer" buyer POST "/api/after-sales/claims" @{
  unitId = $unitId; buyerId = $UID['notary']; title = "Tentative usurpation"; description = "Doit etre reattribue a l appelant (QA)"
  category = 0; priority = 0
} @(200,201,403,422)
$imp = J $r

Step "W8.3" "technician lists claims" tech GET "/api/after-sales/claims?PageNumber=1&PageSize=20" $null @(200) | Out-Null
Step "W8.4" "agent cannot list SAV claims" agent GET "/api/after-sales/claims?PageNumber=1&PageSize=20" $null @(403) | Out-Null
Step "W8.5" "buyer reads own claims" buyer GET "/api/after-sales/claims/mine" $null @(200) | Out-Null

# §6.1 — a technician may only act on a claim ASSIGNED to them, so an
# unassigned claim is refused even though the role is right.
Step "W8.6" "unassigned technician refused" tech PUT "/api/after-sales/claims/$claimId/status" @{
  claimId = $claimId; newStatus = 1; note = "Tentative sans affectation (QA)"
} @(403) | Out-Null

Step "W8.7a" "admin qualifies the claim (UNDER_REVIEW)" admin PUT "/api/after-sales/claims/$claimId/status" @{
  claimId = $claimId; newStatus = 1; note = "Qualification SAV (QA)"
} @(200,204) | Out-Null

Step "W8.7b" "assigning without a technician is refused" admin PUT "/api/after-sales/claims/$claimId/status" @{
  claimId = $claimId; newStatus = 3; note = "Affectation sans technicien (QA)"
} @(400,422) | Out-Null

Step "W8.7c" "admin assigns the claim to the technician" admin PUT "/api/after-sales/claims/$claimId/status" @{
  claimId = $claimId; newStatus = 3; assignedAgentId = $UID['tech']; note = "Affectation SAV (QA)"
} @(200,204) | Out-Null

Step "W8.8" "assigned technician moves it to IN_PROGRESS" tech PUT "/api/after-sales/claims/$claimId/status" @{
  claimId = $claimId; newStatus = 4; note = "Intervention planifiee (QA)"
} @(200,204) | Out-Null

# §6.4 — the impersonation attempt must have landed on the CALLER, never on the
# id they supplied in the body.
if ($imp -and $imp.id) {
  $r2 = Call admin GET "/api/after-sales/claims?PageNumber=1&PageSize=50"
  $all = (J $r2)
  $rows = if ($all.data) { $all.data } else { $all }
  $row = $rows | Where-Object { "$($_.id)" -eq "$($imp.id)" }
  $attributed = if ($row) { $row.buyerId } else { "(not found)" }
  $okAttr = ("$attributed" -eq "$($UID['buyer'])")
  $script:results += [pscustomobject]@{ id="W8.2b"; desc="impersonated claim attributed to the caller"; who="admin"; call="verify buyerId"; got=$(if($okAttr){200}else{0}); want=200; ok=$okAttr; note="attributed to $attributed" }
  Write-Host ("W8.2b  admin  --  {0} impersonated claim attributed to: {1}" -f $(if($okAttr){"PASS"}else{"FAIL"}), $attributed)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- SUMMARY
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "================= RESULTS ================="
$script:results | Format-Table id, who, call, want, got, ok, note -AutoSize -Wrap
$fails = @($script:results | Where-Object { -not $_.ok })
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "PASS: $(@($script:results | Where-Object ok).Count) / $($script:results.Count)   FAIL: $($fails.Count)"
$ctx = [pscustomobject]@{ tag=$tag; projectId=$projectId; immeubleId=$immeubleId; floorId=$floorId; unitId=$unitId; reservationId=$resId; saleId=$saleId; notaryAppointmentId=$naId; handoverId=$hoId; claimId=$claimId }
$ctx | ConvertTo-Json | Out-File "$QA\chain.json" -Encoding utf8
$script:results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Out-File "$QA\chain-results.json" -Encoding utf8
Write-Host "context -> $QA\chain.json"
```
</details>

    /// `VISITOR` is intentionally absent — §6.1 defines it as the

    }

    public async Task<CreateUserByAdminResponse> Handle(CreateUserByAdminCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var roleCode = RoleCodes.Normalize(request.Role);

        var existing = await _userManager.FindByEmailAsync(request.Email);
        if (existing != null)
        {
            throw new Common.Exceptions.ValidationException(new[]
            {
                new ValidationFailure(nameof(request.Email), "Un compte existe déjà avec cet email.")
            });
        }

        var user = new User
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
            UserName = request.Email,
            Email = request.Email,
            FirstName = request.FirstName,
            LastName = request.LastName,
            FirstNameAr = string.Empty,
            LastNameAr = string.Empty,
            PhoneNumber = request.PhoneNumber,
            Discriminator = roleCode
        };

        var creation = await _userManager.CreateAsync(user, request.Password);
        if (!creation.Succeeded)
        {
            var failures = creation.Errors
                .Select(e => new ValidationFailure(e.Code, e.Description));
            throw new Common.Exceptions.ValidationException(failures);
        }

        }

        // ProjectAPI keeps its OWN AspNetUsers table for local FKs
        // (Appointment.SalesAgentId, ProjectMembership.UserId, etc.) — an
        // account that only exists here shows up in role pickers but fails
        // with "User not found" the moment ProjectAPI tries to reference it.
        // Only roles ProjectAPI's TPH model actually maps matter there
        // (SALES_AGENT, NOTARY); other roles still get a plain mirrored row
        // so future FKs against them don't hit the same gap.
        await _projectApiClient.ProvisionUserAsync(new ProvisionUserRequest(
            user.Id, user.Email!, user.FirstName, user.LastName, user.PhoneNumber, roleCode), cancellationToken);

        return new CreateUserByAdminResponse
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            Email = user.Email!,
            Role = roleCode
        };
    }
}

  "content": "import { expect, request, type APIRequestContext, type APIResponse } from \"@playwright/test\";\nimport { ACCOUNTS, AUTH_API, E2E_PASSWORD, PROJECT_API, type RoleKey } from \"./accounts\";\n\nexport interface Session {\n  key: RoleKey;\n  userId: string;\n  token: string;\n  roles: string[];\n}\n\nexport interface LoginResponse {\n  accessToken: string | null;\n  isAutheticated: boolean;\n  roles: string[];\n  user: { id: string; email: string; firstName?: string; lastName?: string };\n}\n\nexport async function loginRaw(userName: string, password = E2E_PASSWORD): Promise<LoginResponse> {\n  const ctx = await request.newContext();\n  try {\n    const res = await ctx.post(`${AUTH_API}/api/User/login`, { data: { userName, password } });\n    expect(res.status(), `login ${userName}`).toBe(200);\n    return (await res.json()) as LoginResponse;\n  } finally {\n    await ctx.dispose();\n  }\n}\n\nconst sessions = new Map<RoleKey, Session>();\n\n/**\n * API session for a role, cached per worker. `fresh` re-logs in — needed when\n * the account's roles changed server-side (e.g. BUYER granted on approval),\n * because roles are baked into the JWT at login.\n */\nexport async function session(key: RoleKey, fresh = false): Promise<Session> {\n  const cached = sessions.get(key);\n  if (cached && !fresh) return cached;\n  const body = await loginRaw(ACCOUNTS[key].userName);\n  expect(body.isAutheticated, `login ${key}`).toBe(true);\n  const s: Session = { key, userId: body.user.id, token: body.accessToken!, roles: body.roles };\n  sessions.set(key, s);\n  return s;\n}\n\nexport class ApiError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    readonly status: number,\n    readonly body: string,\n    readonly call: string,\n  ) {\n    super(`${call} -> HTTP ${status}: ${body.slice(0, 400)}`);\n  }\n}\n\n/** Thin JSON client over ProjectAPI (or AuthAPI) for one role. */\nexport class Api {\n  private constructor(\n    readonly ctx: APIRequestContext,\n    readonly s: Session,\n  ) {}\n\n  static async as(key: RoleKey, fresh = false): Promise<Api> {\n    const s = await session(key, fresh);\n    const ctx = await request.newContext({\n      extraHTTPHeaders: { Authorization: `Bearer ${s.token}`, Accept: \"application/json\" },\n    });\n    return new Api(ctx, s);\n  }\n\n  get userId() {\n    return this.s.userId;\n  }\n\n  /** Raw call: never throws on HTTP status. Use for authorization assertions. */\n  async raw(method: string, path: string, data?: unknown, base = PROJECT_API): Promise<APIResponse> {\n    return this.ctx.fetch(`${base}${path}`, {\n      method,\n      data: data === undefined ? undefined : data,\n      headers: data === undefined ? undefined : { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n    });\n  }\n\n  /** Call that must succeed (2xx); returns parsed JSON (or text when not JSON). */\n  async ok<T = any>(method: string, path: string, data?: unknown, base = PROJECT_API): Promise<T> {\n    const res = await this.raw(method, path, data, base);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    if (!res.ok()) throw new ApiError(res.status(), text, `${this.s.key} ${method} ${path}`);\n    if (!text) return undefined as T;\n    try {\n      return JSON.parse(text) as T;\n    } catch {\n      return text as unknown as T;\n    }\n  }\n\n  get<T = any>(path: string) {\n    return this.ok<T>(\"GET\", path);\n  }\n  post<T = any>(path: string, data?: unknown) {\n    return this.ok<T>(\"POST\", path, data ?? {});\n  }\n  put<T = any>(path: string, data?: unknown) {\n    return this.ok<T>(\"PUT\", path, data ?? {});\n  }\n  patch<T = any>(path: string, data?: unknown) {\n    return this.ok<T>(\"PATCH\", path, data ?? {});\n  }\n  del<T = any>(path: string) {\n    return this.ok<T>(\"DELETE\", path);\n  }\n\n  async dispose() {\n    await this.ctx.dispose();\n  }\n}\n\n/** Asserts the raw response is an authorization/business refusal, not a success. */\nexport async function expectRefused(res: APIResponse, allowed: number[] = [401, 403], what = \"\") {\n  const body = await res.text();\n  expect(allowed, `${what} expected refusal ${allowed.join(\"/\")}, got ${res.status()} ${body.slice(0, 300)}`).toContain(\n    res.status(),\n  );\n}\n"
}

await probe.json() : null;\n      if (body?.isAutheticated) {\n        expect(body.roles, `${account.email} roles`).toContain(account.role);\n        continue;\n      }\n      const res = await ctx.post(`${AUTH_API}/api/User/admin-create`, {\n        data: {\n          email: account.email,\n          firstName: account.provision.firstName,\n          lastName: account.provision.lastName,\n          password: E2E_PASSWORD,\n          phoneNumber: account.provision.phone,\n          role: account.role,\n        },\n      });\n      expect(res.status(), `admin-create ${account.email}: ${await res.text()}`).toBeLessThan(300);\n    }\n  } finally {\n    await ctx.dispose();\n  }\n});\n\nfor (const role of ROLE_PROJECTS) {\n  setup(`sign in ${role.key}`, async ({ page }) => {\n    const account = ACCOUNTS[role.key as RoleKey];\n    // Fails loudly if the account is missing or carries the wrong role.\n    const probe = await loginRaw(account.userName);\n    expect(probe.roles, `${account.email} must carry ${account.role}`).toContain(account.role);\n\n    await page.goto(\"/login\");\n    await page.getByLabel(\"Email\").fill(account.userName);\n    await page.getByLabel(\"Mot de passe\").fill(E2E_PASSWORD);\n    await page.getByRole(\"button\", { name: /connexion|se connecter/i }).click();\n    await expect(page).not.toHaveURL(/\\/login/);\n    const token = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem(\"gpia_token\"));\n    expect(token, \"token stored after login\").toBeTruthy();\n    await page.context().storageState({ path: role.storageState });\n  });\n}\n"
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { authApi, claimsApi } from "../../api";
import { ApiError } from "../../api/http/client";
import type { AfterSaleClaim, ClaimStatus } from "../../types";
import { Async, CLAIM_STATUS_LABEL, Card, Field, Modal, PageHeader, StatusBadge, Table, Tabs } from "../../components/ui";
import { useAsync } from "../../lib/useAsync";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/format";

// Full canonical SAV lifecycle (§5.9) — all 10 states the backend now
// persists (see claimStatus in enums.ts). Previously only 5 legacy states
// were listed here, hiding real claims sitting in the other 5 from every
// filter tab except "All".
const STATUSES: (ClaimStatus | "All")[] = [
  "All",
  "SUBMITTED",
  "UNDER_REVIEW",
  "MORE_INFO_REQUIRED",
  "ASSIGNED",
  "IN_PROGRESS",
  "WAITING_CUSTOMER",
  "RESOLVED",
  "CLOSED",
  "REJECTED",
  "CANCELLED",
];

export default function ClaimsPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>("All");
  const state = useAsync(
    () => claimsApi.list({ pageSize: 50, status: status === "All" ? undefined : status }).then((r) => r.data),
    [status]
  );
  const techniciansState = useAsync(() => authApi.listByRole("TECHNICIAN"), []);

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [assigning, setAssigning] = useState<AfterSaleClaim | null>(null);
  const [resolving, setResolving] = useState<AfterSaleClaim | null>(null);

  // N23 — "Prendre en charge" used to jump straight from SUBMITTED (and even
  // UNDER_REVIEW) to IN_PROGRESS, a transition ClaimStateMachine has never
  // allowed: the real path is SUBMITTED → UNDER_REVIEW → ASSIGNED (a real
  // technician, required server-side) → IN_PROGRESS. The 409 this produced
  // had no on-screen error at all (same class as N14).
  async function setStatusFor(claim: AfterSaleClaim, next: ClaimStatus, extra?: { assignedAgentId?: string; resolutionSummary?: string; note?: string }) {
    setError(null);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await claimsApi.updateStatus(claim.id, next, extra);
      state.reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "Échec de la mise à jour de la réclamation.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function onAssign(agentId: string) {
    if (!assigning || !agentId) return;
    await setStatusFor(assigning, "ASSIGNED", { assignedAgentId: agentId });
    setAssigning(null);
  }

  async function onResolve(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!resolving) return;
    const form = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    const summary = String(form.get("resolutionSummary") || "").trim();
    if (!summary) return;
    await setStatusFor(resolving, "RESOLVED", { resolutionSummary: summary });
    setResolving(null);
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Réclamations SAV" subtitle="Suivi des réclamations après-vente" />
      {error && <p className="form-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
      <Tabs
        tabs={STATUSES.map((s) => ({ key: s, label: s === "All" ? "Toutes" : CLAIM_STATUS_LABEL[s] }))}
        active={status}
        onChange={setStatus}
      />
      <Card>
        <Async state={state} isEmpty={(c) => c.length === 0} empty="Aucune réclamation dans cette catégorie">
          {(claims) => (
          <Table
            keyField={(c) => c.id}
            rows={claims}
            columns={[
              { header: "Titre", render: (c) => c.title },
              { header: "Catégorie", render: (c) => c.category },
              { header: "Priorité", render: (c) => c.priority },
              { header: "Créée le", render: (c) => formatDate(c.createdAt) },
              { header: "Statut", render: (c) => <StatusBadge status={c.status} label={CLAIM_STATUS_LABEL[c.status]} /> },
              {
                header: "",
                render: (c) => (
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
                    {c.status === "SUBMITTED" && (
                      <button className="btn btn-ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setStatusFor(c, "UNDER_REVIEW")}>
                        Mettre en cours d'analyse
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {c.status === "UNDER_REVIEW" && (
                      <button className="btn btn-ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setAssigning(c)}>
                        Affecter un technicien
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {c.status === "ASSIGNED" && (
                      <button className="btn btn-ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setStatusFor(c, "IN_PROGRESS")}>
                        Démarrer l'intervention
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {c.status === "IN_PROGRESS" && (
                      <button className="btn btn-ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setResolving(c)}>
                        Résoudre
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
          )}
        </Async>
      </Card>

      {assigning && (
        <Modal title="Affecter un technicien" onClose={() => setAssigning(null)}>
          <Async state={techniciansState} isEmpty={(t) => t.length === 0} empty="Aucun technicien trouvé.">
            {(technicians) => (
              <Field label="Technicien">
                <select disabled={busy} defaultValue="" onChange={(e) => onAssign(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="" disabled>Sélectionner un technicien</option>
                  {technicians.map((t) => (
                    <option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.name} {t.lastName}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </Field>
            )}
          </Async>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {resolving && (
        <Modal title="Résoudre la réclamation" onClose={() => setResolving(null)}>
          <form onSubmit={onResolve}>
            <Field label="Résumé de la résolution">
              <textarea name="resolutionSummary" rows={3} required disabled={busy} />
            </Field>
            <div className="modal-actions">
              <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy}>
                {busy ? "…" : "Résoudre"}
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setResolving(null)} disabled={busy}>
                Annuler
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
 * to a project, not to the quartier, and are managed on the project page.
 */
export default function QuartiersPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Quartier[] | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Quartier | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function reload() {
    projectsApi
      .listQuartiers()
      .then((list) => {
        setItems(list);
        setLoadError(null);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        setItems([]);
        setLoadError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "Échec du chargement des quartiers.");
      });
  }
  useEffect(reload, []);

  async function onCreate(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = new FormData(e.currentTarget);

    setFormError(null);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await projectsApi.createQuartier({
        name: String(form.get("name")),
        description: String(form.get("description") || ""),
        images: String(form.get("images") || ""),
      });
      setShowCreate(false);
      reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "Échec de la création du quartier.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function onEdit(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editing) return;
    const form = new FormData(e.currentTarget);

    setFormError(null);
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await projectsApi.updateQuartier(editing.id, {
        name: String(form.get("name")),
        description: String(form.get("description") || ""),
        images: String(form.get("images") || ""),
      });
      setEditing(null);
      reload();
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "Échec de la modification du quartier.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  /** Shared by create and edit so the two forms cannot drift apart. */
  function QuartierFields({ value }: { value?: Quartier }) {
    return (
      <>
        <Field label="Nom">
          <input name="name" defaultValue={value?.name ?? ""} maxLength={200} required disabled={busy} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Description">
          <textarea name="description" rows={3} defaultValue={value?.description ?? ""} disabled={busy} />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Images (URLs séparées par des virgules)">
          {/* Une seule colonne texte côté serveur, pas une liste — d'où la
              saisie brute plutôt qu'un téléversement. Les domaines non
              autorisés sont refusés par l'API. */}
          <input name="images" defaultValue={value?.images ?? ""} placeholder="https://…, https://…" disabled={busy} />
        </Field>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Quartiers"
        subtitle="Référentiel des quartiers auxquels les projets sont rattachés"
        actions={<Button onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)}>+ Nouveau quartier</Button>}
      />
      <Card>
        {loadError && <p className="form-error">{loadError}</p>}
        {!items ? (
          <Loading />
        ) : (
          <Table
            keyField={(q) => q.id}
            rows={items}
            emptyLabel="Aucun quartier enregistré"
            columns={[
              { header: "Nom", render: (q) => q.name },
              { header: "Description", render: (q) => q.description || "-" },
              {
                header: "",
                render: (q) => (
                  <button className="btn btn-ghost" onClick={() => setEditing(q)}>
                    Modifier
                  </button>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
        )}
        {/* Pas de suppression : un quartier est référencé par des projets, et
            le supprimer les détacherait silencieusement de leur quartier. */}
      </Card>

      {showCreate && (
        <Modal
          title="Nouveau quartier"
          onClose={() => {
            if (!busy) setShowCreate(false);
          }}
        >
          <form onSubmit={onCreate}>
            {formError && <p className="form-error" role="alert">{formError}</p>}
            <QuartierFields />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Création…" : "Créer"}</Button>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {editing && (
        <Modal
          title={`Modifier — ${editing.name}`}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!busy) setEditing(null);
          }}
        >
          <form onSubmit={onEdit}>
            {formError && <p className="form-error" role="alert">{formError}</p>}
            <p className="muted small">
              Le nom est repris sur la fiche publique de chaque projet rattaché à ce quartier.
            </p>
            <QuartierFields value={editing} />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Enregistrement…" : "Enregistrer"}</Button>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Reads a number input, treating an empty field as "not recorded" rather than 0. */
function optionalNumber(value: FormDataEntryValue | null): number | undefined {
  const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
  return text === "" ? undefined : Number(text);
}

function optionalText(value: FormDataEntryValue | null): string | undefined {
  const text = String(value ?? "").trim();
  return text === "" ? undefined : text;
}

            {project.typeBiens.map((t) => <span key={t.id} className="feature-chip">{t.name}</span>)}
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <div className="page-header" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0 }}>Immeubles</h3>
          {canManageProjects && (
            <Button onClick={() => setShowCreateImmeuble(true)}>+ Nouveau bâtiment</Button>
          )}
        </div>
        <Table
          keyField={(im) => im.id}
          rows={immeubles}
          columns={[
            { header: "Nom", render: (im) => <Link to={`/admin/immeubles/${im.id}`}>{im.name}</Link> },
            { header: "Statut", render: (im) => (im.status ? <StatusBadge status={im.status} /> : "-") },
            { header: "Unités", render: (im) => im.numberOfUnits, align: "right" },
            { header: "Disponibles", render: (im) => im.numberOfAvailableUnites, align: "right" },
            { header: "Prix", render: (im) => `${formatMAD(im.minPrice)} - ${formatMAD(im.maxPrice)}` },
          ]}
        />
      </Card>

      {showEdit && canManageProjects && (
        <Modal
          title="Modifier le projet"
          onClose={() => {
            if (!savingEdit) setShowEdit(false);
          }}
        >
          <form onSubmit={onEdit}>
            {editError && <p className="form-error" role="alert">{editError}</p>}
            <Field label="Nom"><input name="name" defaultValue={project.name} required disabled={savingEdit} /></Field>
            <Field label="Localisation"><input name="location" defaultValue={project.location} required disabled={savingEdit} /></Field>
            <Field label="Adresse"><input name="address" defaultValue={project.address ?? ""} disabled={savingEdit} /></Field>
            <Field label="Type"><input name="type" defaultValue={project.type ?? ""} disabled={savingEdit} /></Field>
            <Field label="Statut">
              {/* Seuls les codes §3 que le backend legacy sait écrire honnêtement
                  (voir enums.ts). COMPLETED déverrouille les visites finales (§5.6)
                  et n'a pas de valeur legacy honnête ; DRAFT est pourtant requis à
                  la création (FR-CMS-001) — lacune backend, pas un choix UI. */}
              <select name="statusGlobal" defaultValue={project.statusGlobal ?? "PLANNED"} disabled={savingEdit}>
                <option value="PLANNED">PLANNED</option>
                <option value="IN_PROGRESS">IN_PROGRESS</option>
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Field label="Garantie (mois)">
              {/* §8 — la durée est copiée et gelée sur chaque vente à sa
                  création : la modifier ici ne raccourcit ni n'allonge une
                  garantie déjà accordée. */}
              <input
                name="warrantyMonths"
                type="number"
                min="1"
                max="360"
                defaultValue={project.warrantyMonths}
                disabled={savingEdit}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field label="Description"><textarea name="description" rows={3} defaultValue={project.description ?? ""} disabled={savingEdit} /></Field>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={savingEdit}>
              {savingEdit ? "Enregistrement…" : "Enregistrer"}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
</details>

                Description = request.QuartierDescription ?? string.Empty,
                Images = request.QuartierImages ?? string.Empty

            quartierId = newQuartier.Id;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Réservations" subtitle="Suivi des réservations d'unités" />
      {isSalesAgent && (
        <div className="page-header-actions" style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <Button onClick={openCreateReservation}>Créer une réservation</Button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="list-filters">
        <label className="list-filter-select">
          <span>Projet</span>
          <select value={filterProjectId} onChange={(e) => setFilterProjectId(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">Tous les projets</option>
            {(filterProjects ?? []).map((project) => (
              <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                {project.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
      <Tabs
        tabs={STATUSES.map((s) => ({
          key: s,
          label: s === "All" ? "Toutes" : (RESERVATION_STATUS_LABEL[s] ?? s),
        }))}
        active={status}
        onChange={setStatus}
      />
      <Card>
        {!reservations ? (
          <Loading />
        ) : (
          <Table
            keyField={(r) => r.id}
            rows={reservations}
            columns={[
              {
                // Buyer and unit share one cell: they identify the same row and
                // reading them together is how an agent recognises a
                // reservation. This also stops the unit label — the longest
                // string in the table — from setting the width of its own column.
                header: "Acheteur / Unité",
                render: (r) => (
                  <span className="cell-lede">
                    <span>{`${r.name ?? ""} ${r.lastName ?? ""}`.trim() || "—"}</span>
                    <Link className="cell-sub" to={`/admin/units/${r.unitId}`}>
                      {reservedUnitLabel(r.unitDetails, r.unitId)}
                    </Link>
                  </span>
                ),
              },
              {
                // The two money columns were unrelated numbers side by side.
                // What matters is the deposit as a share of the price, so the
                // ratio is drawn and the exact figures stay readable under it.
                header: "Dépôt / Prix",
                align: "right",
                render: (r) => (
                  <DepositRatio amount={r.reservationAmount} total={r.totalPropertyPrice} />
                ),
              },
              { header: "Date", render: (r) => <span className="num">{formatDate(r.reservationDate)}</span> },
              {
                header: "Statut",
                render: (r) => <StatusBadge status={r.status} label={RESERVATION_STATUS_LABEL[r.status]} />,
              },
              {
                header: "",
                render: (r) => (
                  <button
                    className="btn btn-ghost"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActionError(null);
                      // The list row (GetReservationsResponse) has no CoBuyers
                      // field at all, so opening the dialog on `r` directly always
                      // showed zero co-buyers regardless of what was actually
                      // saved (N7) — an admin approving a joint purchase would
                      // never see it was one. GetReservationById does return
                      // CoBuyers; fetch it before showing the dialog.
                      setSelected(r);
                      setSelectedLoading(true);
                      reservationsApi
                        .getById(r.id)
                        .then((full) => setSelected(full ?? null))
                        .catch(() => {})
                        .finally(() => setSelectedLoading(false));
                    }}
                  >
                    Détails
                  </button>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
        )}
      </Card>

      {selected && (
        <Modal title={`Réservation — ${selected.name} ${selected.lastName}`} onClose={() => {
            setSelected(null);
            setEditingReservation(false);
          }}>
          <dl className="detail-list">
            <dt>CIN</dt><dd>{selected.cin ?? "-"}</dd>
            <dt>Email</dt><dd>{selected.email ?? "-"}</dd>
            <dt>Téléphone</dt><dd>{selected.phoneNumber ?? "-"}</dd>
            <dt>Unité</dt><dd>{selected.unitDetails ?? selected.unitId}</dd>
            <dt>Montant réservation</dt><dd>{formatMAD(selected.reservationAmount)}</dd>
            <dt>Prix total</dt><dd>{formatMAD(selected.totalPropertyPrice)}</dd>
            {selected.catalogPrice != null && (<><dt>Prix catalogue</dt><dd>{formatMAD(selected.catalogPrice)}</dd></>)}
            {selected.discount != null && selected.discount > 0 && (<><dt>Remise</dt><dd>{formatMAD(selected.discount)}</dd></>)}
            {selected.finalPrice != null && (<><dt>Prix final</dt><dd>{formatMAD(selected.finalPrice)}</dd></>)}
            {selected.expiresAt && (<><dt>Expire le</dt><dd>{formatDate(selected.expiresAt)}</dd></>)}
            <dt>Statut</dt><dd><StatusBadge status={selected.status} label={RESERVATION_STATUS_LABEL[selected.status]} /></dd>
            {selected.adminNote && (<><dt>Note admin</dt><dd>{selected.adminNote}</dd></>)}
          </dl>

          {selectedLoading && <Loading />}

          {!selectedLoading && selected.coBuyers.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <h4 style={{ marginTop: 20, marginBottom: 10 }}>Co-acquéreurs</h4>
              <Table
                keyField={(c) => c.crmContactId}
                rows={selected.coBuyers}
                columns={[
                  { header: "Nom", render: (c) => `${c.firstName} ${c.lastName}` },
                  { header: "E-mail", render: (c) => c.email ?? "-" },
                  { header: "Téléphone", render: (c) => c.phone ?? "-" },
                  {
                    header: "Part",
                    render: (c) => (c.ownershipPercent != null ? `${c.ownershipPercent}%` : "-"),
                    align: "right",
                  },
                ]}
              />
            </>
          )}

          {!selectedLoading && (
            <ReservationDocumentsPanel
              reservationId={selected.id}
              documents={selected.documents}
              onChange={(documents) => setSelected((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, documents } : prev))}
              canManage={canSubmitReservations}
            />
          )}

          {/* §5.7/§6 — the sale sits between approval and the notarial act, so
              it is shown from APPROVED onwards. On a CONVERTED file the panel
              is the record of the sale the notary confirmed. */}
          {!selectedLoading && (selected.status === "APPROVED" || selected.status === "CONVERTED") && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
              <SalePanel
                reservationId={selected.id}
                reservationStatus={selected.status}
                canManage={canSubmitReservations}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* §5.8 — a handover may only exist once the sale is finalised. */}
          {selected.status === "CONVERTED" && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
              <HandoverPanel reservationId={selected.id} canManage={canSubmitReservations} />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Cross-table context: where this unit stands in the full lifecycle */}
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: 20, marginBottom: 10 }}>Parcours de l'unité</h4>
          <ReservationJourney unitId={selected.unitId} />
          <Link to={`/admin/units/${selected.unitId}`} className="link-chip" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            Ouvrir la fiche unité →
          </Link>
          {actionError && <p className="form-error" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>{actionError}</p>}

          {/* §12.2 — the correction itself. Without this, "demander une
              correction" could only ever be answered by resubmitting the same
              unchanged file, or by cancelling and losing its history. */}
          {(selected.status === "DRAFT" || selected.status === "CHANGES_REQUESTED") &&
            canSubmitReservations &&
            (editingReservation ? (
              <form onSubmit={saveReservationEdit} style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
                <h4 style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>Corriger la réservation</h4>
                <Field label="Prénom"><input name="name" defaultValue={selected.name ?? ""} disabled={acting} /></Field>
                <Field label="Nom"><input name="lastName" defaultValue={selected.lastName ?? ""} disabled={acting} /></Field>
                <Field label="CIN"><input name="cin" defaultValue={selected.cin ?? ""} disabled={acting} /></Field>
                <Field label="E-mail"><input name="email" type="email" defaultValue={selected.email ?? ""} disabled={acting} /></Field>
                <Field label="Téléphone"><input name="phoneNumber" defaultValue={selected.phoneNumber ?? ""} disabled={acting} /></Field>
                <Field label="Prix total (MAD)">
                  <input name="totalPropertyPrice" type="number" min="1" step="0.01" defaultValue={selected.totalPropertyPrice} disabled={acting} />
                </Field>
                <Field label="Montant réservation (MAD)">
                  <input name="reservationAmount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" defaultValue={selected.reservationAmount} disabled={acting} />
                </Field>
                <Field label="Remise (MAD)">
                  {/* §5.3 — le prix final est recalculé serveur-side à partir du
                      prix catalogue gelé à la création, jamais d'un prix courant. */}
                  <input name="discount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" defaultValue={selected.discount ?? 0} disabled={acting} />
                </Field>
                <div className="modal-actions">
                  <Button type="submit" disabled={acting}>{acting ? "Enregistrement…" : "Enregistrer"}</Button>
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setEditingReservation(false)} disabled={acting}>
                    Annuler
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </form>
            ) : (
              <div className="modal-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEditingReservation(true)} disabled={acting}>
                  Corriger la réservation
                </Button>
              </div>
            ))}

          {/* Actions are rendered conditionally, never hidden with the `hidden`
              attribute: an authorization rule must not depend on a UA stylesheet
              that any future `display` on .btn would silently defeat. */}
          {selected.status === "DRAFT" && canSubmitReservations && (
            <div className="modal-actions">
              <Button onClick={() => act("submit", selected)} disabled={acting}>
                {acting ? "…" : "Soumettre"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
          {selected.status === "SUBMITTED" && canReviewReservations && (
            <div className="modal-actions">
              {!isOwnAgentReservation && (
                <Button onClick={() => act("approve", selected)} disabled={acting}>
                  {acting ? "…" : "Approuver"}
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => act("requestChanges", selected)} disabled={acting}>
                Demander une correction
              </Button>
              <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => act("reject", selected)} disabled={acting}>
                Refuser
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
          {selected.status === "SUBMITTED" && canReviewReservations && isOwnAgentReservation && (
            <p className="muted small" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
              Vous avez soumis cette réservation : sa validation revient à un administrateur de projet (§6.4).
            </p>
          )}
          {selected.status === "CHANGES_REQUESTED" && (
            <div className="modal-actions">
              {canSubmitReservations && (
                <Button onClick={() => act("submit", selected)} disabled={acting}>
                  {acting ? "…" : "Renvoyer pour validation"}
                </Button>
              )}
              {canReviewReservations && (
                <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => act("reject", selected)} disabled={acting}>
                  Refuser
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {/* Pas de bouton "vendu" : le passage en CONVERTED n'existe que via le
              résultat notarial PURCHASE_COMPLETED (§5.3/§5.7), jamais à la main. */}
          {selected.status === "APPROVED" && canReviewReservations && (
            <div className="modal-actions">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => act("cancel", selected)} disabled={acting}>
                Annuler
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </Modal>
      )}

      {createOpen && (
        <Modal
          title="Créer une réservation"
          onClose={() => {
            if (!creating) setCreateOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          <form onSubmit={createReservation}>
            <p className="muted small" style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>
              Le serveur confirme la disponibilité au moment de la création.
            </p>
            {createError && <p className="form-error" role="alert">{createError}</p>}
            {!projects ? (
              <Loading />
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Projet → Immeuble → (type) → Bien, following the §3 hierarchy. */}
                <Field label="Projet">
                  <select
                    value={selectedProjectId}
                    onChange={(event) => selectProject(event.target.value)}
                    required
                    disabled={creating}
                  >
                    <option value="">Sélectionner un projet</option>
                    {projects.map((project) => (
                      <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                        {project.name}
                      </option>

export default function NotaryAppointmentsPage() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<NotaryAppointment[] | null>(null);

  // §5.7 FR-NOT-003 — the responsible agent (or an admin) REQUESTS the
  // appointment and assigns the notary; §18.4 — confirming it and recording the
  // outcome are the notary's own acts. The API enforces both; this only avoids
  // offering an action it would refuse (§1.2).
  const canRequest = !!user?.roles.some((r) => ADMINS_AGENTS.includes(r));
  const canDecide = !!user?.roles.some((r) => ADMINS_NOTARY.includes(r));

  const [requestOpen, setRequestOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reservations, setReservations] = useState<Reservation[] | null>(null);
  const [notaries, setNotaries] = useState<User[] | null>(null);
  const [reqReservationId, setReqReservationId] = useState("");
  const [reqNotaryId, setReqNotaryId] = useState("");
  const [reqDate, setReqDate] = useState("");
  const [reqTaxFees, setReqTaxFees] = useState("");
  const [reqTahfidFees, setReqTahfidFees] = useState("");
  const [requesting, setRequesting] = useState(false);
  const [requestError, setRequestError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [completing, setCompleting] = useState<NotaryAppointment | null>(null);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState<NotaryAppointmentOutcome | "">("");
  const [outcomeNote, setOutcomeNote] = useState("");
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);

  function reload() {
    notaryApi.listAppointments({ pageSize: 50 }).then((r) => setItems(r.data));
  }
  useEffect(reload, []);

  // The lifecycle is shared with final-visit appointments (§47.3): a request
  // must be confirmed before it can be marked completed — no direct jump.
  async function confirm(id: string) {

      setRequesting(false);
    }

OverrideReason { get; set; }\n}\n\npublic class FinalizeProjectResponse\n{\n    public Guid ProjectId { get; set; }\n    public string Status { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    public string BusinessPhase { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    public decimal ComputedProgressPercent { get; set; }\n    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n}\n\npublic class FinalizeProjectHandler : IRequestHandler<FinalizeProjectCommand, FinalizeProjectResponse>\n{\n    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;\n    private readonly ProjectScopeService _projectScope;\n    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;\n\n    public FinalizeProjectHandler(ApplicationDbContext db, ProjectScopeService projectScope, ICurrentUser currentUser)\n    {\n        _db = db;\n        _projectScope = projectScope;\n        _currentUser = currentUser;\n    }\n\n    public async Task<FinalizeProjectResponse> Handle(FinalizeProjectCommand request, CancellationToken ct)\n    {\n        var project = await _db.Set<Project>()\n            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == request.ProjectId, ct)\n            ?? throw new NotFoundException($\"Project {request.ProjectId} not found.\");\n\n        await _projectScope.EnsureProjectAccessAsync(request.ProjectId, ct);\n\n        if (!request.Confirm)\n        {\n            throw new BusinessRuleException(\n                BusinessErrorCodes.ValidationFailed,\n                \"La finalisation du projet exige une confirmation explicite.\");\n        }\n\n        var phase = ProjectStatusCodes.GetBusinessPhase(project.StatusGlobal);\n        if (phase != ProjectStatusCodes.Phase.EnLivraison)\n        {\n            throw new BusinessRuleException(\n                BusinessErrorCodes.InvalidStatusTransition,\n                $\"Seul un projet en livraison peut être finalisé (phase actuelle : {phase}).\",\n                StatusCodes.Status409Conflict);\n        }\n\n        var milestones = await _db.Set<ConstructionMilestone>()\n            .Where(m => m.ProjectId == request.ProjectId)\n            .ToListAsync(ct);\n        var totalWeight = milestones.Sum(m => m.WeightPercent);\n        var doneWeight = milestones.Where(m => m.Status == MilestoneStatus.Completed).Sum(m => m.WeightPercent);\n        var progress = totalWeight > 0 ? Math.Round(doneWeight / totalWeight * 100, 2) : 0m;\n\n        if (request.OverrideIncompleteProgress && !_currentUser.IsGlobalAdmin)\n        {\n            throw new BusinessRuleException(\n                BusinessErrorCodes.Unauthorized,\n                \"Seul un administrateur global peut finaliser un projet dont l'avancement est incomplet.\",\n                StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden);\n        }\n\n        if (request.OverrideIncompleteProgress && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.OverrideReason))\n        {\n            throw new BusinessRuleException(\n                BusinessErrorCodes.ValidationFailed,\n                \"Une dérogation sur l'avancement incomplet exige un motif documenté.\");\n        }\n\n        if (progress < 100m && !request.OverrideIncompleteProgress)\n        {\n            throw new BusinessRuleException(\n                \"PROJECT_PROGRESS_INCOMPLETE\",\n                $\"L'avancement pondéré est de {progress:N2}% ; 100% est requis pour finaliser le projet, \" +\n                \"sauf dérogation explicite d'un administrateur global.\");\n        }\n\n        var decidedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;\n        var actorUserId = _currentUser.UserId;\n\n        project.StatusGlobal = ProjectStatusCodes.Archived;\n\n        // Same audit carrier as CompleteProject until the audit_logs table exists.\n        _db.Add(new ConstructionUpdate\n        {\n            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),\n            ProjectId = request.ProjectId,\n            VersionNo = 1,\n            ProgressPercent = progress,\n            TitleFr = \"Projet finalisé\",\n            TitleEn = \"Project finalised\",\n            DescriptionFr = request.OverrideIncompleteProgress\n                ? $\"Finalisation avec dérogation par {actorUserId ?? \"?\"} le {decidedAt:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC \" +\n                  $\"(avancement pondéré réel {progress:N2}%). Motif : {request.OverrideReason}\"\n                : $\"Projet finalisé par {actorUserId ?? \"?\"} le {decidedAt:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm} UTC — \" +\n                  \"phase précédente : EN_LIVRAISON. Le projet est désormais en lecture seule.\",\n            Visibility = UpdateVisibility.Internal,\n            AuthorUserId = actorUserId,\n            PublishedAt = decidedAt,\n            CreatedAt = decidedAt\n        });\n\n        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);\n\n        return new FinalizeProjectResponse\n        {\n            ProjectId = project.Id,\n            Status = ProjectStatusCodes.Archived,\n            BusinessPhase = ProjectStatusCodes.Phase.Finalise,\n            ComputedProgressPercent = progress,\n            Message = \"Projet finalisé : il est désormais en lecture seule.\"\n        };\n    }\n}\n"
}

    private static string ToBlobName(string url)
    {
        var path = new Uri(url).AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/');
        var prefix = $"{ClaimAttachmentStorage.ContainerName}/";

        return path.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? path[prefix.Length..]
            : path;
    }

/// <summary>
/// Who may see a claim, and therefore its evidence (§6.3/§6.4).
///
/// One place rather than two: upload and download must agree, and a check that
/// exists twice is a check that will eventually disagree with itself.
/// </summary>
internal static class ClaimAccess
{
    public static Task EnsureCanAccessAsync(
        ApplicationDbContext db, ICurrentUser user, AfterSaleClaim claim, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // Admins and technicians handle claims across the SAV desk — that is
        // the whole point of RoleGroups.AdminsTechnicians on this controller.
        var isInternal = user.Roles.Any(r => RoleCodes.Internal.Contains(r, StringComparer.Ordinal));
        if (isInternal) return Task.CompletedTask;

        // A buyer sees their own claim and nothing else.
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(claim.BuyerId) &&
            string.Equals(claim.BuyerId, user.UserId, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        throw BusinessRuleException.BuyerScopeDenied();
    }
}

import type { AfterSaleClaim, ClaimAttachment, PaginatedResponse } from "../../types";
import type { ClaimsApi } from "../interfaces";
import { ApiError, buildQuery, getToken, projectFetch } from "./client";
import { config } from "../../lib/config";
import { claimCategory, claimPriority, claimStatus } from "./enums";

const USER_STORAGE_KEY = "gpia_user";

function currentUserId(): string {
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_STORAGE_KEY);
  if (!raw) return "";
  try {
    return (JSON.parse(raw) as { id?: string }).id ?? "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

interface AfterSaleClaimDto extends Omit<AfterSaleClaim, "category" | "priority" | "status"> {
  category: number;
  priority: number;
  status: number;
}

function fromWire(dto: AfterSaleClaimDto): AfterSaleClaim {
  return {
    ...dto,
    category: claimCategory.fromInt(dto.category),
    priority: claimPriority.fromInt(dto.priority),
    status: claimStatus.fromInt(dto.status),
  };
}

export const claimsApi: ClaimsApi = {
  // §20/§24.2 — evidence is uploaded as a FILE to a private container. The
  // create-claim command used to take a list of client-supplied URLs; it no
  // longer does, and the blob address is never handed back to the client.
  async uploadAttachment(claimId, file) {
    const form = new FormData();
    // Field name must bind to UploadClaimAttachmentCommand.File.
    form.append("File", file);

    return projectFetch<ClaimAttachment>(`/api/after-sales/claims/${claimId}/attachments`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: form,
    });
  },

  async downloadAttachment(attachmentId) {
    // Streamed through the API so the perimeter check applies to the file, not
    // just to the row describing it; the bearer token has to travel with it,
    // which a plain <a href> could not do.
    const res = await fetch(
      `${config.projectApiUrl}/api/after-sales/claims/attachments/${attachmentId}/content`,
      { headers: getToken() ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${getToken()}` } : {} }
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new ApiError(res.status, null, await res.text().catch(() => ""));
    }
    return res.blob();

    public async Task<ProjectResponse> Handle(UpdateProjectCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var project = await _projectRepository.GetByIDAsync(request.Id)
            ?? throw new NotFoundException($"Project with ID {request.Id} not found.");

        await _projectScope.EnsureProjectAccessAsync(request.Id, cancellationToken);

        // §7.2 — only what the client is ADDING is checked. An edit form resends
        // the images it was given, so validating the whole list would make a
        // project whose catalogue predates this policy unsavable for a reason
        // that has nothing to do with the edit being made (§9 — existing data
        // is preserved, not retroactively rejected).
        _media.EnsureImageUrls(request.Images, "Images", project.Images);
        if (request.Module3DLink is not null && request.Module3DLink != project.Module3DLink)
        {
            _media.Ensure3DLink(request.Module3DLink, "Module3DLink");
        }
        _media.EnsureImageUrl(request.QuartierImages, "QuartierImages");

        // Update Quartier if needed
        if (request.QuartierId.HasValue)
        {
            project.QuartierId = request.QuartierId;
        }
        else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.QuartierName))
        {
            var newQuartier = new Quartier
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Name = request.QuartierName!,
                Description = request.QuartierDescription ?? "",
                Images = request.QuartierImages ?? ""
            };

            await _quartierRepository.InsertAsync(newQuartier);
            await _quartierRepository.SaveAsync();
            project.QuartierId = newQuartier.Id;
        }

        // Update project fields
        project.Name = request.Name ?? project.Name;
        project.Location = request.Location ?? project.Location;
        project.Address = request.Address ?? project.Address;
        project.Description = request.Description ?? project.Description;
        project.Module3DLink = request.Module3DLink ?? project.Module3DLink;
        project.Images = request.Images ?? project.Images;
        project.Type = request.Type ?? project.Type;

        // §3 / §15.3 — COMPLETED is a gate, not a field. It unlocks final-visit
        // requests, so it may only be reached through CompleteProjectCommand,
        // which verifies 100% weighted progress, an explicit confirmation and a
        // real end date, and records the decision. Letting a generic PUT write it
        // would reopen the gate to anyone who can edit a project.
        if (request.StatusGlobal != null)
        {
            var target = ProjectStatusCodes.Normalize(request.StatusGlobal);
            var current = ProjectStatusCodes.Normalize(project.StatusGlobal);

            if (target == ProjectStatusCodes.Completed && current != ProjectStatusCodes.Completed)
            {
                throw new BusinessRuleException(
                    BusinessErrorCodes.InvalidStatusTransition,
                    "Un projet ne peut être marqué COMPLETED que via la commande de finalisation " +
                    "(POST /api/construction/projects/{id}/complete), qui vérifie l'avancement à 100%.",
                    StatusCodes.Status409Conflict);
            }

            project.StatusGlobal = target;
        }

        project.OverAllProgress = request.OverallProgress ?? project.OverAllProgress;
```

    public CreateNotaryAppointmentHandler(

        ProjectScopeService projectScope,
        NotaryEligibilityService eligibility)
    {

        _purchaseTotals = purchaseTotals;
        _projectScope = projectScope;
        _eligibility = eligibility;

  "content": "import { expect, type Page } from \"@playwright/test\";\n\n/** Answers every window.confirm/prompt on the page (prompt gets `promptValue`). */\nexport function acceptDialogs(page: Page, promptValue = \"\") {\n  page.on(\"dialog\", (dialog) => {\n    void dialog.accept(dialog.type() === \"prompt\" ? promptValue : undefined);\n  });\n}\n\n/** Opens a reservation's detail dialog from /admin/reservations, filtered on its project. */\nexport async function openReservation(page: Page, projectName: string, buyerLastName: string) {\n  await page.goto(\"/admin/reservations\");\n  const filter = page.locator(\"label.list-filter-select\").getByRole(\"combobox\");\n  await expect(filter.locator(\"option\", { hasText: projectName })).toHaveCount(1);\n  await filter.selectOption({ label: projectName });\n  const row = page.getByRole(\"row\").filter({ hasText: buyerLastName });\n  await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);\n  await row.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Détails\" }).click();\n  const dialog = page.getByRole(\"dialog\", { name: new RegExp(`Réservation — .*${buyerLastName}`) });\n  await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();\n  return dialog;\n}\n\n/** Waits until the ProjectAPI call matching `urlPart` (and method) completes, returning its status. */\nexport async function responseStatus(page: Page, urlPart: string | RegExp, method: string, action: () => Promise<unknown>) {\n  const [res] = await Promise.all([\n    page.waitForResponse((r) => r.request().method() === method && (typeof urlPart === \"string\" ? r.url().includes(urlPart) : urlPart.test(r.url()))),\n    action(),\n  ]);\n  return res.status();\n}\n"
}
