import type { AdminSalesPage, Sale, UserSalesSummary } from "../../types";
import type { SalesApi } from "../interfaces";
import { buildQuery, projectFetch } from "./client";

interface SaleItemDto {
  saleId: string;
  unitId: string;
  saleDate: string;
  totalPrice: number;
  paid: number;
  remaining: number;
}

interface UserSalesResponseDto {
  sales: SaleItemDto[];
  totalPrice: number;
  totalPaid: number;
  totalRemaining: number;
}

export const salesApi: SalesApi = {
  async listAll(params) {
    return projectFetch<AdminSalesPage>(
      `/api/sales${buildQuery({
        PageNumber: params?.pageNumber ?? 1,
        PageSize: params?.pageSize ?? 100,
        Search: params?.search || undefined,
        ProjectId: params?.projectId || undefined,
      })}`
    );
  },

  async getByUser(userId) {
    const dto = await projectFetch<UserSalesResponseDto>(`/api/sales/user/${userId}`);
    const summary: UserSalesSummary = {
      totalPrice: dto.totalPrice,
      totalPaid: dto.totalPaid,
      totalRemaining: dto.totalRemaining,
      // Backend doesn't return projectName/unitDetails/payments on this endpoint —
      // joining against Immeuble/Unit data would need extra calls, left blank for now.
      sales: dto.sales.map((s) => ({
        saleId: s.saleId,
        unitId: s.unitId,
        projectName: "",
        unitDetails: "",
        price: s.totalPrice,
        totalPaid: s.paid,
        remaining: s.remaining,
        saleDate: s.saleDate,
        payments: [],
      })),
    };
    return summary;
  },

  // §5.7/§6 — the sale draft flow. The backend derives the buyer, the unit and
  // the deposit from the reservation, so none of them are sent from here.
  async createDraft(body) {
    return projectFetch<Sale>("/api/sales", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
  },

  async getByReservation(reservationId) {
    // 200 with a null body is the normal "no sale yet" answer, not an error.
    const sale = await projectFetch<Sale | null>(`/api/sales/by-reservation/${reservationId}`);
    return sale ?? null;
  },

  async updateDraft(saleId, body) {
    return projectFetch<Sale>(`/api/sales/${saleId}`, {
      method: "PUT",
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
  },

  async cancelDraft(saleId, reason) {
    return projectFetch<Sale>(`/api/sales/${saleId}/cancel`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
    });
  },
};

using FluentValidation;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Appointments.Entities;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.FinalVisits.Entities;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Application.NotaryAppointments.UpdateNotaryAppointment;

public class UpdateNotaryAppointmentValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateNotaryAppointmentCommand>
{
    public UpdateNotaryAppointmentValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.Id)
            .NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage("Id is required.");

        // Statuses come from the shared appointment lifecycle (§47.3), reused by
        // final-visit and notary appointments alike — see AppointmentAttemptStatus.
        RuleFor(x => x.Status)
            .Must(status => string.IsNullOrEmpty(status) || Enum.TryParse<AppointmentAttemptStatus>(status, out _))
            .WithMessage(
                "Status must be one of: " +
                string.Join(", ", Enum.GetNames(typeof(AppointmentAttemptStatus))) + ".");

        // §5.7 — the outcome vocabulary is fixed and distinct from the status one.
        RuleFor(x => x.Outcome)
            .Must(outcome => string.IsNullOrEmpty(outcome) || NotaryOutcomeCodes.TryParse(outcome, out _))
            .WithMessage("Outcome must be one of: " + string.Join(", ", NotaryOutcomeCodes.All) + ".");

        RuleFor(x => x.OutcomeNote)
            .MaximumLength(2000);
```

import type { NotaryAppointment, NotaryBlock, PaginatedResponse, WeeklyAvailabilitySlot } from "../../types";
import type { NotaryApi } from "../interfaces";
import { buildQuery, idempotent, newIdempotencyKey, projectFetch } from "./client";
import { notaryAppointmentStatus } from "./enums";

// Wire DTO: legacy status strings ("Requested"/"Confirmed"/…). The §5.7 outcome
// travels as its canonical UPPER_SNAKE code — unlike status, the backend never
// spoke a legacy vocabulary for it, so there is nothing to translate.
interface NotaryAppointmentDto extends Omit<NotaryAppointment, "status" | "outcome"> {
  status: string;
  outcome?: string | null;
  outcomeNote?: string | null;
}

function fromWire(dto: NotaryAppointmentDto): NotaryAppointment {
  return {
    ...dto,
    status: notaryAppointmentStatus.fromLegacy(dto.status) ?? "REQUESTED",
    outcome: (dto.outcome as NotaryAppointment["outcome"]) ?? undefined,
  };
}

function toWire(data: Partial<NotaryAppointment> & { outcomeNote?: string }) {
  const { status, outcome, previousAppointmentId: _prev, ...rest } = data;
  return {
    ...rest,
    ...(status ? { status: notaryAppointmentStatus.toLegacy(status) } : {}),
    // Sent verbatim: the backend CHECK constraint accepts exactly these codes.
    ...(outcome ? { outcome } : {}),
  };
}

// NotaryBlockDto/CreateNotaryBlockResponse both serialize as startUtc/endUtc,
// not the from/to shape NotaryBlock uses — reading either wire response
// directly as NotaryBlock left from/to undefined, so every block's dates
// rendered as "-" after reload (F6).
interface NotaryBlockWireDto {
  id: string;
  startUtc: string;
  endUtc: string;
  reason?: string | null;
}

function fromWireBlock(dto: NotaryBlockWireDto, notaryId: string): NotaryBlock {
  return { id: dto.id, notaryId, from: dto.startUtc, to: dto.endUtc, reason: dto.reason ?? undefined };
}

    });

Api.as(\"globalAdmin\");\n  return admin.get<NotaryDto>(`/api/NotaryAppointments/${id}`);\n}\n\nasync function appointmentsOf(reservationId: string) {\n  const admin = await Api.as(\"globalAdmin\");\n  return (await admin.all<NotaryDto>(\"/api/NotaryAppointments\")).filter((a) => a.reservationId === reservationId);\n}\n\nconst localInput = (d: Date) => new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);\n\nasync function confirmFromList(page: Page, buyerLastName: string) {\n  await page.goto(\"/admin/notary-appointments\");\n  const row = page.getByRole(\"row\").filter({ hasText: buyerLastName });\n  await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);\n  await row.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Confirmer\" }).click();\n}\n\ntest.describe(\"Acheteur\", { tag: \"@buyer\" }, () => {\n  test(\"buyer_appointment_request_created_with_status_requested\", async ({ page }) => {\n    const j = await st.journey(\"FINAL_VISIT\");\n    await page.goto(`/my/properties/${j.reservationId}`);\n    await page.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Demander un RDV notaire\" }).click();\n    const when = new Date(Date.now() + (40 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300)) * 86400000);\n    when.setHours(14, 0, 0, 0);\n    await page.getByLabel(\"Date et heure souhaitées\").fill(localInput(when));\n    await page.getByRole(\"button\", { appointmentsOf(j.reservationId))[0];\n    expect(created.status).toMatch(/^Requested$/i);\n    const buyer = await Api.as(\"buyer\", true);\n    expect((await \"Rendez-vous notaire\", exact: true }) });\n    await expect(history.getByRole(\"row\")).toHaveCount(2); // header + the request\n  });\n\n  test(\"buyer_cannot_set_purchase_completed\", async ({ expect(page.getByRole(\"radio\")).toHaveCount(0);\n\n    const buyer = await Api.as(\"buyer\", true);\n    await expectRefused(\n      await buyer.raw(\"PUT\", `/api/NotaryAppointments/${j.notaryAppointmentId}`, { id: j.notaryAppointmentId, status: \"Completed\", outcome: \"PURCHASE_COMPLETED\" }),\n      [403],\n      \"buyer sets PURCHASE_COMPLETED\",\n    );\n    const after = await appointment(j.notaryAppointmentId!);\n    expect(after.outcome ?? null).toBeNull();\n    expect(after.status).toMatch(/^Confirmed$/i);\n    const admin = await Api.as(\"globalAdmin\");\n    expect((await admin.get<{ status: number }>(`/api/Reservations/${j.reservationId}`)).status).toBe(1);\n  });\n});\n\nfor (const [tag, label] of [[\"@agent\", \"Agent\"],     public async Task<List<MyReservationSummary>> Handle(GetMyReservationsQuery request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var userId = _currentUser.UserId;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userId)) return new List<MyReservationSummary>();

        return await _db.Set<Reservation>()
            .Where(r => r.BuyerId == userId)
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.ReservationDate)
            .Select(r => new MyReservationSummary
            {
                Id = r.Id,
                UnitId = r.UnitId,
                UnitDetails = r.UnitDetails,

                TotalPropertyPrice = r.TotalPropertyPrice,
                FinalPrice = r.FinalPrice,
                ReservationDate = r.ReservationDate,
                ValidatedAt = r.ValidatedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);
    }
}

  const immeubleId = searchParams.get("immeuble") ?? "";

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

      if (immeubleId) {
        const [im, units] = await Promise.all([
          immeublesApi.getById(immeubleId),
          immeublesApi.listUnits(immeubleId),
        ]);
        if (cancelled) return;
        setImmeuble(im ?? null);
        setUnit(units.find((u) => u.id === unitId) ?? null);
        return;
      }

      // Fallback: there is no GET /units/{id}, so locate the unit by scanning
      // each immeuble's units until we find its owner.

        const match = units.find((u) => u.id === unitId);
        if (match) {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setImmeuble(im);
          setUnit(match);

      if (!cancelled) setUnit(null);

    return () => {

          </Card>
          <Card className="stat-card">

            <span className="stat-value">{unit.numberOfBedrooms ?? "-"}</span>
          </Card>

﻿using FluentValidation;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Exceptions;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Models;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.CreateAfterSaleClaim;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.GetClaims;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.GetMyClaims;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.RespondToClaimResolution;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.UpdateClaimStatus;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Security;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Users.Entities;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using ValidationException = FluentValidation.ValidationException;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/after-sales/claims")]
[Authorize] // §6.3 SAV: buyer creates own (C/M propre); technician/admin handle (C/M affecté).
public class AfterSaleClaimsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;

    public AfterSaleClaimsController(IMediator mediator, ICurrentUser currentUser)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _currentUser = currentUser;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<object>> Create([FromBody] CreateAfterSaleClaimCommand cmd, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // BuyerId is taken from the token, NOT merely defaulted from it.
        //
        // It used to be filled in only when the body left it blank, so a buyer
        // could send someone else's id and have the claim attributed to them:
        // the ownership check downstream verifies that THAT id owns the unit,
        // which it does, so the impersonation passed every check. §6.4 —
        // "un acheteur ne peut accéder qu'à ses propres données".
        //
        // An internal caller (admin/technician) may still file on a buyer's
        // behalf, which is a real workflow — a claim phoned in to the SAV desk.
        // Only a buyer/prospect caller is pinned to themselves.
        //
        // MUST go through ICurrentUser, not a raw ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier
        // lookup — this system's JWTs carry the id under a custom "userId"
        // claim, which ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier never matches (see CurrentUser.cs).
        var isInternal = _currentUser.Roles.Any(r => RoleCodes.Internal.Contains(r, StringComparer.Ordinal));

        if (!isInternal && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_currentUser.UserId))
        {
            cmd.BuyerId = _currentUser.UserId;
        }
        else if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cmd.BuyerId) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_currentUser.UserId))
        {
            cmd.BuyerId = _currentUser.UserId;
        }

        try
        {
            var id = await _mediator.Send(cmd, ct);
            // No GetById handler exists, so return 200 with the id payload.
            return Ok(new { id });
        }
        catch (ValidationException ex)
        {
            // Handler throws FluentValidation.ValidationException for business rules
            return ValidationProblem(detail: ex.Message);
        }
    }

    [HttpPost("{claimId:guid}/attachments")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(Application.Sales.AfterSales.Attachments.ClaimAttachmentResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status422UnprocessableEntity)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UploadAttachment(
        Guid claimId,
        [FromForm] Application.Sales.AfterSales.Attachments.UploadClaimAttachmentCommand command,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (command.File is null || command.File.Length == 0)
        {
            return BadRequest("No file uploaded.");
        }

        command.ClaimId = claimId;
        return Ok(await _mediator.Send(command, ct));
    }

    [HttpGet("attachments/{attachmentId:guid}/content")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DownloadAttachment(Guid attachmentId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var file = await _mediator.Send(
            new Application.Sales.AfterSales.Attachments.DownloadClaimAttachmentQuery
            {
                AttachmentId = attachmentId
            }, ct);

        return File(file.Content, file.ContentType, file.FileName);
    }

    public Guid ClaimId { get; set; }
    public IFormFile File { get; set; } = null!;
}

public class ClaimAttachmentResponse
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid ClaimId { get; set; }
    public string? FileName { get; set; }
    public string? ContentType { get; set; }
    public long? SizeBytes { get; set; }
    public DateTime UploadedAt { get; set; }
}

public class UploadClaimAttachmentHandler : IRequestHandler<UploadClaimAttachmentCommand, ClaimAttachmentResponse>
{
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;
    private readonly IBlobStorageService _blobStorage;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;

    public UploadClaimAttachmentHandler(
        ApplicationDbContext db,
        IBlobStorageService blobStorage,
        ICurrentUser currentUser)
    {
        _db = db;
        _blobStorage = blobStorage;
        _currentUser = currentUser;
    }

    public async Task<ClaimAttachmentResponse> Handle(UploadClaimAttachmentCommand request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var claim = await _db.Set<AfterSaleClaim>()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.ClaimId, ct)
            ?? throw new NotFoundException($"Claim {request.ClaimId} not found.");

        await ClaimAccess.EnsureCanAccessAsync(_db, _currentUser, claim, ct);

        var contentType = request.File.ContentType ?? "application/octet-stream";

        if (!ClaimAttachmentStorage.AllowedContentTypes.Contains(contentType, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            throw new BusinessRuleException(
                BusinessErrorCodes.ValidationFailed,
                $"Type de fichier non autorisé ({contentType}). " +
                "Formats acceptés : photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), vidéo (MP4, MOV) ou PDF.");
        }

        if (request.File.Length > ClaimAttachmentStorage.MaxSizeBytes)
        {
            throw new BusinessRuleException(
                BusinessErrorCodes.ValidationFailed,
                $"Fichier trop volumineux ({request.File.Length / 1024 / 1024} Mo). Maximum : 25 Mo.");
        }

        // Guid prefix so re-uploading "photo.jpg" never overwrites the first,
        // and the claim id groups a file with the claim it evidences.
        var blobName = $"{claim.Id}/{Guid.NewGuid()}_{Path.GetFileName(request.File.FileName)}";

        using var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream();
        var url = await _blobStorage.ForContainer(ClaimAttachmentStorage.ContainerName)
            .UploadAsync(blobName, stream, contentType, ct);

# Workflow — Buyer account activation by invitation

**Status: fully traced**, across both services. This is the only workflow in the
solution that crosses the ProjectAPI ↔ AuthenticationAPI boundary at runtime.

## Business purpose

A buyer can be recorded and approved without ever having a login — an agent
enters a walk-in on the reservation's own identity fields. Approval then issues a
single-use invitation so that person can set their own password and reach the
buyer portal. The system must never invent a password for them, and never create
a second CRM contact for someone it already knows.

Ownership is split deliberately: **ProjectAPI owns the invitation and the CRM
contact; AuthenticationAPI is the only service that ever calls
`UserManager.CreateAsync`.**

## Participants

| Layer | Component |
|---|---|
| Frontend | `features/auth/ActivateAccountPage.tsx` (route `/activate?token=…`) |
| Adapter | `api/http/invitationsApi.ts` |
| ProjectAPI | `ApproveReservationHandler`, `AccountInvitationService`, `InvitationsController`, `AcceptInvitationHandler`, `AuthenticationApiClient` |
| AuthenticationAPI | `InternalController`, `ProvisionInternalUserHandler` |
| Tables | `AccountInvitations`, `CrmContacts`, `Reservations` (ProjectAPI) · `AspNetUsers`, `AspNetRoles`, `AspNetUserRoles` (AuthenticationAPI) |

## Step-by-step trace

### 1 — Approval issues the token

Inside `ApproveReservationHandler`, **after** the approval transaction commits
(so a failure here never rolls back a real approval):

'''
if (hasBuyerAccount)            → GrantBuyerRoleAsync(...)
else if (PrimaryContactId != null) → IssueInvitationAsync(...)
'''

`IAccountInvitationService.IssueAsync(crmContactId)`:
